title: Whatsapp Status Saver
summary: Download and save WhatsApp statuses easily – photos & videos
description:
Whatsapp Status Saver makes it easy to download and save your favorite statuses from WhatsApp in just one tap.

Whether it’s photos, videos, or stories shared by your contacts, you can quickly view, save, and manage them directly from your device.

✨ Key Features:

• Save WhatsApp status photos and videos instantly
• Clean and simple user interface
• Built-in media viewer for images and videos
• Download multiple statuses quickly
• Share or repost saved statuses easily
• No login required

⚡ How it works:

1. Open WhatsApp and view statuses
2. Open Whatsapp Status Saver
3. Select and save your favorite statuses

📂 Smart Storage:

All downloaded statuses are saved securely on your device, allowing you to access them anytime, even offline.

🔒 Privacy & Safety:

This app does not collect or store any personal data. It only accesses media files that are already available on your device.

⚠️ Disclaimer:

This app is not affiliated with WhatsApp Inc. or Meta. WhatsApp is a trademark of Meta Platforms, Inc.

Please respect copyright and obtain permission before saving or sharing others’ content.
Download now and never miss a status again!
